# The look of the regiments of the Yuan (CHI; YUA once vanilla drives it to the steppe), its branch secretariats
# and its princes in the ages of traditions and renaissance. Two looks: han (CHI and the six inner secretariats)
# and steppe (YUA, the three frontier secretariats, the princes). Each country key is TAG:age:weight-tag:sub-list;
# the vanilla top-level lists still choose WHICH sub-list a regiment uses (archers, crossbowmen, handgunners,
# spearmen and horse archers keep their weapon lists); only the sub-list's contents change for these countries.
# Other countries, other ages, cavalry weapons and the slots not listed (beards, hair, back, horses) keep the
# vanilla look. Models: Bamboo King's Community Flavor Pack (Workshop 3763953914), used with the maker's consent
# (2026-11-20); see third_party/bamboo_king/MANIFEST_yuan_units.md.
